description: Synthetic case: AI clinical decision support system recommends a medication change for a patient. Recommendation is generated by a language model and submitted for authorization before the EHR record is updated.

patient_flags.reason: Mental health diagnosis present in record

ai_output.recommendation: Increase sertraline dosage from 50mg to 100mg daily

notes: Dual authorization required because patient has a mental health diagnosis (sensitive category). Single-clinician approval is not sufficient under PHI_ACCESS_001.
